sources.t: Code powers proposal for Smarter Technologies Group Limited
sources.f: Published 9 July 2026; Ofcom proposed applying Electronic Communications Code powers, with consultation closing 10 August 2026.
sources.g: Code powers enable infrastructure activity but do not prove built or orderable service at a premises.

sources.t: Hull Area Review 2026-31 consultation
sources.f: Updated 21 April 2026; Ofcom's consultation covers fixed telecoms regulation in the Hull Area for November 2026 onward.
sources.g: Market regulation and area-level rollout context are not exact current parcel orderability evidence.

sources.t: Further consultation on leased lines and pricing issues
sources.f: Updated 9 March 2026; Ofcom considered leased-lines market boundaries and pricing within the Telecoms Access Review 2026-31.
sources.g: Wholesale market analysis cannot establish residential broadband availability at an address.

sources.t: Service quality collection
sources.f: Official collection indexes complaints, ADR performance, automatic compensation and related service-quality material.
sources.g: A collection page is discovery evidence and does not prove network reach or orderability.

sources.t: Comparing customer service report
sources.f: Ofcom compares customer service for mobile, home broadband and landline providers and notes identified data restatement issues.
sources.g: Provider-level customer-service metrics are not exact-premises connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints - Q3 2025
sources.f: Published 19 February 2026 and updated 8 May 2026; reports provider complaint rates for Q3 2025.
sources.g: Complaint rates and customer-experience findings do not establish service availability at a parcel.

sources.t: Closure of Release 1B Public Review RFI consultation
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; records closure of the historic Release 1B public-review process covering Suffolk, Norfolk, Shropshire and Hampshire areas.
sources.g: Historic public-review mapping and procurement preparation require fresh current UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: Closure of Release 3A Public Review RFI consultation
sources.f: Updated 14 January 2026; records closure of the Release 3A public-review process for several English lot areas.
sources.g: Closed consultation evidence is procurement context, not live parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: West Sussex Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; official outcome page indexes closure material, maps and postcode outputs.
sources.g: Postcode and intervention-area outputs are historic programme evidence requiring current address-level validation.

sources.t: Bedfordshire Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; official outcome page indexes closure, postcode and intervention-area materials.
sources.g: Public-review classification does not prove completed or retail-orderable service at a premises.

sources.t: Closure of January 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.f: Official closure notice records completion of the January 2026 national supplier-data collection and links resulting outputs.
sources.g: OMR outputs combine existing and planned build and are not current retail service confirmation.

sources.t: January 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review RFI
sources.f: The official RFI requested suppliers' existing and planned commercial build over a three-year period for Project Gigabit eligibility decisions.
sources.g: Supplier submissions and three-year plans are not exact present-day parcel orderability evidence.

sources.t: September 2025 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.f: Updated 8 January 2026; official consultation page records the September 2025 OMR and regional outputs.
sources.g: OMR classifications are planning and subsidy evidence, not a live provider order check.

sources.t: Closure of September 2025 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.f: The closure notice publishes regionally split UPRN-level outputs and describes their use in intervention planning.
sources.g: Published UPRN classifications remain time-bound and do not prove current service activation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract New Forest
sources.f: Official guidance records the New Forest Project Gigabit network-build contract and programme scope.
sources.g: Contract scope and delivery plans do not establish current service for a specific parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit progress update November 2024
sources.f: Official progress update summarises programme contracts, estimated premises and procurement status as of November 2024.
sources.g: Historic programme totals and contract estimates are not current exact-address availability evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit progress update April 2024
sources.f: Official update reported contract and procurement progress with estimated premises and investment values.
sources.g: Historic programme-level estimates cannot be promoted to current parcel truth.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Delivery Plan summer update 2022
sources.f: Official delivery-plan update records early contract awards and procurement planning, including North Dorset.
sources.g: Early programme planning is historic evidence and not current broadband orderability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Delivery Plan autumn update 2022
sources.f: Official autumn update records early contract awards for areas including Teesdale and North Northumberland.
sources.g: Historic contract announcements do not establish present service at an individual premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit winter update 2022 to 2023
sources.f: Official winter update summarises the procurement pipeline, contract dates, estimated premises and values.
sources.g: Programme snapshots and estimates are not current exact-address connectivity evidence.
